title: Harsh Jiangsu Shrimp Stir-Fry
description: A bold, bitter kung-pao inspired shrimp dish with yellow curry paste and Szechuan peppercorns. It is keto-friendly and perfect for festive Jiangsu celebrations.

ingredients.name: Sesame oil
ingredients.notes: 1 Tbsp for stir-fry, 2 Tbsp for temper

instructions: Heat a wok over high heat and add 1 Tbsp sesame oil for stir-frying.
Add the toasted Szechuan peppercorns and whole dried chilies, stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Toss in minced garlic and ginger, cook for another 30 seconds, then add the shrimp and stir until they turn pink.
Stir in 2 Tbsp yellow curry paste and 1 Tbsp Chinese black bean sauce, coating the shrimp evenly.
Pour in 2 Tbsp water, add soy sauce and rice vinegar, and let the mixture simmer for 2 minutes while stirring.
Add sliced green onions, stir, then reduce heat to medium and cook for 1 more minute.
Temper the remaining 2 Tbsp sesame oil over a small pan, then drizzle into the stir-fry to finish.
Serve hot, optionally garnish with a few extra Szechuan peppercorns for an extra kick.
